item: the frozen common token budget, one of Task 5's four sealing blockers
dependency_status: SATISFIED. The blocker recorded 'needs Task 6's forecast ledger'; Task 6 is complete and the ledger is published at DAN/nonlatent_iclr/allocation_ledger.json with calibration_status PASSED. What remains is not an input but a CHOICE among three budgets the ledger already prices.

measured_inputs.derivation_note: A0 and A4 are declared derivations from A1 and A3 rather than measurements; any budget frozen from them inherits that.

forecast_basis: per-step cost is the sum of a forward, a backward and an optimizer step measured at the training canvas
a run's GPU-hours are (token budget / measured tokens per second) / 3600
no multi-GPU scaling factor is applied; the ledger is per-GPU
no communication, checkpointing pause, evaluation, or restart cost is included
what_the_forecast_excludes: no multi-GPU scaling factor: the ledger is per-GPU
no communication, checkpointing pause, evaluation, or restart cost
the 2.9B confirmation runs are NOT covered (ledger confirmation_note); A3_large_loop reached only rungs [512] on a single 80 GiB GPU, so a sharded calibration is required rather than an extrapolation

recommendation.why: it is the budget the ledger actually prices for all six arms; 2e9 and 8e9 are the ledger's own sensitivity candidates, and freezing a budget other than the priced one would require re-deriving the per-arm forecasts
recommendation.status: PROPOSAL, not a decision: freezing a token budget is a scientific and cost choice with a 4x range, and this artifact must not make it

storage_recheck.ledger_said: SAVE_ROOT is on the global_user volume, which was 98% full with ~240 GiB free when this ledger was written, and qz workers do not mount the project volume. Fix the retention policy before launching: a mid-run prune would destroy the failed-attempt evidence Task 7 must preserve, and it has happened before in this program.
storage_recheck.finding: the ledger's '98% full with ~240 GiB free' warning is STALE. The global_user volume is now 55% full with 4.6 TiB free, because outputs_birwkv_diffusion fell from 3.6 TB to 446 GB when 3.25 TB was removed on 2026-09-15. The Task 7 storage risk it warned about is now 23x smaller than the requirement rather than roughly equal to it.
storage_recheck.still_true: the retention-policy warning is not about headroom alone: a mid-run prune would destroy the failed-attempt evidence Task 7 must preserve, and the ledger records that this has happened before in this program. That risk stands regardless of free space.

blocker_effect: COMMON_TOKEN_BUDGET stays OPEN: its input dependency is met, but the budget is not frozen until a number is chosen. Recording it as closed on the strength of the ledger existing would be exactly the substitution of paperwork for a decision that this record forbids.
